conceptPrompt:
Invent ONE brand-new Singapore/Malaysian hawker-food spirit FAMILY for the game Hawker Hunt.
It must be a real or highly plausible hawker dish, turned into a cute collectible monster family of 3 evolution stages.
Design goals: every dish must be UNIQUE (no collision with existing pets); may resemble the style but never be identical.
SPECIES FORM for this whole family (all 3 stages share it, but grow up): an upright bipedal DRAGON-person: horned reptilian head, scaled humanoid body, a tail held clear behind the legs, small folded wings tucked to the SIDES (not over the arms). Stage 1 may be a rounder baby version, but stages 2–3 MUST be describable as an upright bipedal figure with arms/legs/claws clearly separate from the body (this is required so the 2D art can be auto-rigged into an animated 3D model). Write each stage's theme so an artist would naturally draw that upright, limbs-apart pose.
No specific direction — free creative choice.

Return JSON with: seriesId (ascii kebab-case, unique), foodOrigin {en,zh}, element (one of metal/wood/water/fire/earth), flavor (one of bitter/sour/salty/sweet/spicy per 五行五味), and stages: an array of EXACTLY 3 objects each { id (ascii kebab-case, unique per stage), stage (1|2|3), name{en,zh}, description{en,zh}, theme, skillIdeas[] }.
Keep every stage consistent with this art DNA: Chibi anthropomorphic Singapore hawker-food creature mascot, big expressive cartoon eyes, rounded soft chunky body, thick painterly cartoon shading (not flat vector, not realistic), warm friendly collectible-monster design, full body head-to-toe, standing, slight 3/4 front view facing camera, cohesive with a unified collectible set of food spirits.


DO NOT duplicate any of these already-used dishes or names (you MAY be stylistically similar, but the dish, the name and the id MUST be distinct and unique):
Dishes: Hainanese Chicken Rice, 海南雞飯, Laksa, 叻沙, Bak Kut Teh, 肉骨茶, Kueh Lapis, 九層糕, Kaya Toast, 咖椰吐司, Chilli Crab, 辣椒蟹, Satay, 沙嗲, Kopi O, 咖啡烏, Chai Tow Kway, 菜頭粿, Rojak, 囉喏, Oyster Omelette, 蠔煎, Char Kway Teow, 炒粿條, Curry Puff, 咖喱卜, Roti Prata, 印度煎餅, Chendol, 煎蕊, Chilli Padi, 辣椒, Garlic, 蒜頭, Lemongrass, 香茅, Rice Ball, 飯團, Rice Vermicelli, 米粉, Egg, 雞蛋, Fresh Shrimp, 鮮蝦, Coconut Milk, 椰漿, Kueh Tutu, 嘟嘟糕, Nasi Lemak, 椰漿飯

description.en: Concentrated essence of Otak-Otak, fuel for evolution.
description.zh: 濃縮嘅烏達精華，進化嘅燃料。

description.en: A freshly wrapped baby spirit born from aromatic, spiced fish paste. It loves to roll around in warm charcoal ash to keep its banana-leaf wrapper toasted and fragrant.
description.zh: 誕生於芳香辛辣魚肉泥中的新鮮幼體精靈。它最愛在溫熱的炭灰中打滾，好讓身上的香蕉葉外衣保持微焦與芬芳。

stages.theme: A cute, chubby baby dragon-person standing upright, wearing a half-peeled green banana leaf like a diaper wrap. Its scales are a soft, warm orange-pink, with tiny lemongrass-like horns on its head. Its small claws are held out to the sides, with tiny charred banana-leaf wings folded snugly against its ribs, and a plump tail pointing straight back.

description.en: Steeped in rich coconut milk and wild spices, this dragon has learned the art of charcoal grilling. Its skin is perfectly toasted, releasing a mouth-watering aroma whenever it swings its claws.
description.zh: 浸潤了濃郁椰漿與野生香料，這隻龍人已掌握了炭火燒烤的奧秘。它那烤得恰到好處的皮膚在揮舞雙爪時，會散發出令人垂涎的香氣。

stages.theme: An upright bipedal dragon warrior with toasted, dark-orange fish-paste scales and charcoal grill marks. It wears a protective vest of woven green banana leaves secured with wooden toothpicks. Its claws are held apart from its body in a confident combat stance, with sturdy folded leaf-wings tucked at its sides and its long tail sweeping the ground behind its legs.

description.en: The absolute master of the grill, Otah Pyrolord Chong commands the sacred flames of the charcoal pit. It can unleash a torrent of spicy, aromatic heat that perfectly cooks anything in its path.
description.zh: 炭火烤爐的絕對主宰，烏達炎領掌控著神聖的炭坑烈焰。它能釋放出混雜著香料與高溫的熱浪，將前方的對手完美「炙烤」。

stages.theme: A majestic bipedal dragon king standing in a powerful, open-armed pose with claws fully separated from its body. It features grand horns shaped like singed coconut leaf ribs and glowing orange scales with masterfully charred grates. A magnificent cape of scorched banana leaves drapes behind its back, accented by small, fiercely folded wings tucked close to its sides.

description.en: A freshly wrapped baby spirit born from aromatic, spiced fish paste. It loves to roll around in warm charcoal ash to keep its banana-leaf wrapper toasted and fragrant.
description.zh: 誕生於芳香辛辣魚肉泥中的新鮮幼體精靈。它最愛在溫熱的炭灰中打滾，好讓身上的香蕉葉外衣保持微焦與芬芳。

Its small claws are held out to the sides, with tiny charred banana-leaf wings folded snugly against its ribs, and a plump tail pointing straight back.

description.en: Releases a puff of aromatic coconut and lemongrass smoke to blind and burn the enemy.
description.zh: 吐出帶有椰香與香茅氣味的濃煙，燻眼並灼傷敵人。

description.en: Snaps at the enemy with spicy, chili-infused fish paste that leaves a lingering sting.
description.zh: 用混入辣椒的魚蓉輕咬敵人，造成持續的刺痛。

description.en: Thrusts forward with sharp bamboo skewers, piercing defenses with spicy heat.
description.zh: 用鋒利的竹籤向前猛刺，以辛辣的熱力穿透敵方防禦。

description.en: Unleashes a wave of intense heat and smoky aroma from the charcoal grill.
description.zh: 釋放出一股來自炭火烤爐的熾熱高溫與濃郁煙燻香氣。

description.en: Deluges the battlefield in a boiling torrent of spicy, sambal-infused fish paste.
description.zh: 向戰場傾瀉滾燙而辛辣的參巴魚漿洪流，吞噬所有敵人。

description.en: Summons a raging storm of burning coconut-shell charcoal embers to incinerate everything.
description.zh: 召喚狂暴的椰殼炭火餘燼風暴，將一切燃燒殆盡。
